S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No.321 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Siddharth Bankoti, learned legal-aid counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned D.A.G. along with Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. An application seeking exemption from the requirement of filing affidavit in support of bail application has been filed.
For the reasons indicated, exemption application (IA/2/2024) is allowed.
4. This is an appeal against conviction filed under Section 374 of Cr.P.C. through legal-aid counsel.

By the impugned judgment dated 23.04.2024 passed by learned Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Pauri Garhwal in Special Sessions Trial No.03 of 2022, appellant was convicted for offence punishable under Sections 376(3) IPC and Section 5(j)(ii)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012 and sentenced to 20 years' rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.20,000/-.
5.

6. Admit the appeal.
7. Let trial court record be summoned.
8.
In the meantime, objection to the Bail Application (IA/1/2024) be filed.
